rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: Harry, come with me. Don't look behind you. I'll explain, but you need to come with me now.
rows.text: [urgent] [breathing heavily] Harry, come with me. Don't look behind you. I'll explain, but you need to come with me now.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: You've just come across the room and grabbed me. What am I supposed to think? Tell me what you've seen.
rows.text: [frightened] You've just come across the room and grabbed me. What am I supposed to think? Tell me what you've seen.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: That would have gone straight through me. You saw that coming, didn't you? That's why you ran.
rows.text: [shaken] That would have gone straight through me. You saw that coming, didn't you? That's why you ran.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: I saw something above you. I didn't know what it was going to do. Harry, you're looking at the floor. Look at me.
rows.text: [urgent] I saw something above you. I didn't know what it was going to do. Harry, you're looking at the floor. Look at me.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: I'm looking at the hole where I was standing. Give me a second. I don't even know which way we're going.
rows.text: [breathing heavily] I'm looking at the hole where I was standing. Give me a second. I don't even know which way we're going.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: Neither do I, yet. But the couples are moving and we're moving with them. For the moment, that's all I've got.
rows.text: [nervous] Neither do I, yet. But the couples are moving and we're moving with them. For the moment, that's all I've got.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: We can't leave her like that. She's still reaching for someone. If I can get my wand clear, I can try to break the ice.
rows.text: [frightened] We can't leave her like that. She's still reaching for someone. If I can get my wand clear, I can try to break the ice.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: And if you stop beside her, I'll have two people I can't get out. Watch your heel. Look at what's happening to it.
rows.text: [quietly] And if you stop beside her, I'll have two people I can't get out. Watch your heel. Look at what's happening to it.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: It was doing the same thing to me. I didn't even feel it. I was going to stand right there.
rows.text: [angry] It was doing the same thing to me. I didn't even feel it. I was going to stand right there.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: You saw someone who needed help. I'm not telling you that was wrong. I'm telling you the floor doesn't care why you stop.
rows.text: [nervous] You saw someone who needed help. I'm not telling you that was wrong. I'm telling you the floor doesn't care why you stop.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: Do you think I don't understand that? I understand it. I just don't know how to walk away while she's looking at us.
rows.text: [raising voice] Do you think I don't understand that? I understand it. I just don't know how to walk away while she's looking at us.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: I don't know how to help her yet. I wish I had something better to say, but I don't. We need to find what's doing this.
rows.text: [defensive] I don't know how to help her yet. I wish I had something better to say, but I don't. We need to find what's doing this.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: Then that's what we're doing. We're not finding a door and pretending we didn't see her. If we get a chance, we go back.
rows.text: [angry] Then that's what we're doing. We're not finding a door and pretending we didn't see her. If we get a chance, we go back.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: If we can reach her without being caught ourselves, yes. But don't pull away from me without telling me. I nearly lost you just then.
rows.text: [voice trembling] If we can reach her without being caught ourselves, yes. But don't pull away from me without telling me. I nearly lost you just then.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: There's someone in the glass, over my shoulder. Don't turn us around. I want to see what it does if we change direction.
rows.text: [angry] There's someone in the glass, over my shoulder. Don't turn us around. I want to see what it does if we change direction.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: I can see the mask. Are you sure it isn't another couple behind us? The reflection's full of people.
rows.text: [voice trembling] I can see the mask. Are you sure it isn't another couple behind us? The reflection's full of people.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: There. Nobody else did that. It waited for me, then took the same step. Whatever it is, it's watching us.
rows.text: [frustrated] There. Nobody else did that. It waited for me, then took the same step. Whatever it is, it's watching us.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: Or following us. I don't like the way it's closing the distance. Can you still see it when we turn away from the window?
rows.text: [defensive] Or following us. I don't like the way it's closing the distance. Can you still see it when we turn away from the window?

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: Not yet. I can't watch it and watch the floor at the same time. Tell me before you change the step, will you?
rows.text: [breathing heavily] Not yet. I can't watch it and watch the floor at the same time. Tell me before you change the step, will you?

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: I will. And don't keep looking over my shoulder like that. Every time you do, I think something's already behind me.
rows.text: [quietly] I will. And don't keep looking over my shoulder like that. Every time you do, I think something's already behind me.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: Harry, are you hurt? You're holding your breath. I need you to tell me if it caught you.
rows.text: [whispers] Harry, are you hurt? You're holding your breath. I need you to tell me if it caught you.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: It didn't. I thought it had for a second. Listen to the orchestra. There are two beats before each one lands.
rows.text: [tense] It didn't. I thought it had for a second. Listen to the orchestra. There are two beats before each one lands.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: You heard that while it was coming at your head? I heard the ice hit. I didn't hear anything before it.
rows.text: [urgent] You heard that while it was coming at your head? I heard the ice hit. I didn't hear anything before it.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: I wasn't listening the first time either. But it's the same phrase. If I'm right, we can move before it chooses where we're standing.
rows.text: [frustrated] I wasn't listening the first time either. But it's the same phrase. If I'm right, we can move before it chooses where we're standing.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: And if you're wrong, we're moving into an arrow instead of away from one. Tell me exactly what you want me to do.
rows.text: [quietly] And if you're wrong, we're moving into an arrow instead of away from one. Tell me exactly what you want me to do.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: Come across me on the second beat. Not away from me, across. I'll turn us. I know it looks too narrow, but I think there's room.
rows.text: [frightened] Come across me on the second beat. Not away from me, across. I'll turn us. I know it looks too narrow, but I think there's room.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: I thought we'd left it too late. For a moment I couldn't tell if you'd moved or if I'd pulled you down.
rows.text: [angry] I thought we'd left it too late. For a moment I couldn't tell if you'd moved or if I'd pulled you down.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: You didn't pull me down. I nearly tripped over my own foot. Please don't tell me you thought I had that under control.
rows.text: [voice trembling] You didn't pull me down. I nearly tripped over my own foot. Please don't tell me you thought I had that under control.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: You recognized it. Don't tell me to watch my feet. I am watching my feet, and I'm asking you what that mark is.
rows.text: [breathing heavily] [angry] You recognized it. Don't tell me to watch my feet. I am watching my feet, and I'm asking you what that mark is.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: It's a Malfoy ward. I thought it was dead. I didn't think there was anything left that could do this.
rows.text: [nervous] [voice trembling] It's a Malfoy ward. I thought it was dead. I didn't think there was anything left that could do this.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: Your family's magic is firing arrows at us, and you were going to wait until when to tell me? Until another one missed?
rows.text: [angry] [raising voice] Your family's magic is firing arrows at us, and you were going to wait until when to tell me? Until another one missed?

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: I recognized it just now. You saw me recognize it. Don't turn that into me knowing everything before you walked into the room.
rows.text: [defensive] [voice breaking] I recognized it just now. You saw me recognize it. Don't turn that into me knowing everything before you walked into the room.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: You knew to pull me into the dance. You knew not to stop. Every time I ask something, there's another thing you haven't said.
rows.text: [frustrated] You knew to pull me into the dance. You knew not to stop. Every time I ask something, there's another thing you haven't said.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: I saw what happened to the people who stopped. That's not the same as knowing how to undo it. I am frightened too, Harry.
rows.text: [nervous] I saw what happened to the people who stopped. That's not the same as knowing how to undo it. I am frightened too, Harry.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: Then tell me what you know, even if it isn't enough. I can deal with you being frightened. I can't deal with guessing which answers you're keeping from me.
rows.text: [breathing heavily] Then tell me what you know, even if it isn't enough. I can deal with you being frightened. I can't deal with guessing which answers you're keeping from me.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: I know whose ward it is. I thought it couldn't work anymore. I don't know who's using it now. That's what I can tell you.
rows.text: [defensive] I know whose ward it is. I thought it couldn't work anymore. I don't know who's using it now. That's what I can tell you.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: All right. Then we start there. But if you recognize something else, I need to hear it before I have to ask.
rows.text: [urgent] All right. Then we start there. But if you recognize something else, I need to hear it before I have to ask.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: Behind you. Harry, raise your wand. Those strings are coming straight at us.
rows.text: [voice trembling] Behind you. Harry, raise your wand. Those strings are coming straight at us.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: It's round my wrist. Don't pull me that way, it's tightening. I can't get the wand up.
rows.text: [breathing heavily] It's round my wrist. Don't pull me that way, it's tightening. I can't get the wand up.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: I'm not pulling your arm. I'm trying to keep you on your feet. Let your elbow come down. You're fighting it and it's getting tighter.
rows.text: [urgent] I'm not pulling your arm. I'm trying to keep you on your feet. Let your elbow come down. You're fighting it and it's getting tighter.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: I can feel it getting tighter. I don't know how I'm supposed to let it take my arm without losing the wand.
rows.text: [frustrated] I can feel it getting tighter. I don't know how I'm supposed to let it take my arm without losing the wand.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: Keep your fingers closed. Let me take your weight for a step. I can get my heel on the line if you give me a little room.
rows.text: [quietly] Keep your fingers closed. Let me take your weight for a step. I can get my heel on the line if you give me a little room.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: I thought it was going to break it. I could feel it pulling right up to my shoulder.
rows.text: [angry] I thought it was going to break it. I could feel it pulling right up to my shoulder.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: Can you open your fingers? Slowly. I'm not asking you to pretend it doesn't hurt. I need to know if you can still hold the wand.
rows.text: [frightened] Can you open your fingers? Slowly. I'm not asking you to pretend it doesn't hurt. I need to know if you can still hold the wand.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: Draconia, the armor behind you. Don't turn toward it. There's a trolley beside your left foot.
rows.text: [firmly] Draconia, the armor behind you. Don't turn toward it. There's a trolley beside your left foot.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: You nearly went down. I knew you were going to kick it, but I didn't know you were going to throw your whole weight after it.
rows.text: [urgent] You nearly went down. I knew you were going to kick it, but I didn't know you were going to throw your whole weight after it.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: Neither did I. My foot slipped. Are you all right? You caught me with the arm it just hurt.
rows.text: [breathing heavily] Neither did I. My foot slipped. Are you all right? You caught me with the arm it just hurt.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: I'll find out when we aren't doing this. For now, stay close enough that I don't have to catch you from across the room.
rows.text: [angry] I'll find out when we aren't doing this. For now, stay close enough that I don't have to catch you from across the room.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: Harry, I'm not trying to make this harder for you. I saw it coming and there wasn't time to do it neatly.
rows.text: [quietly] Harry, I'm not trying to make this harder for you. I saw it coming and there wasn't time to do it neatly.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: I know you weren't. I thought I'd lost you for a second. That's what I'm trying to say.
rows.text: [frightened] I know you weren't. I thought I'd lost you for a second. That's what I'm trying to say.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: It isn't just in the glass anymore. Look past the chair. It's here, and it's still doing what we do.
rows.text: [firmly] It isn't just in the glass anymore. Look past the chair. It's here, and it's still doing what we do.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: I'm trying to turn away from it. I can feel myself trying, but my feet keep taking me back. Harry, can you feel that?
rows.text: [frightened] I'm trying to turn away from it. I can feel myself trying, but my feet keep taking me back. Harry, can you feel that?

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: Yes. Don't fight it so hard you fall. Give me a second to look. It's making us repeat the step, and the figure knows where we'll be.
rows.text: [raising voice] Yes. Don't fight it so hard you fall. Give me a second to look. It's making us repeat the step, and the figure knows where we'll be.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: Can you break the floor lines with your wand? If you can open one gap, we might be able to get out of the pattern.
rows.text: [urgent] Can you break the floor lines with your wand? If you can open one gap, we might be able to get out of the pattern.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: I can't keep aiming down while those things are coming at us. There's another way. The red table on our left. Could you turn it onto its side?

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: If you get me close enough to reach under the edge. Why? Harry, look at me. What are you about to bring down?
rows.text: [quietly] If you get me close enough to reach under the edge. Why? Harry, look at me. What are you about to bring down?

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: The chandelier. Across the ice, not on us. I need the table between us and whatever comes off it when it hits.
rows.text: [angry] The chandelier. Across the ice, not on us. I need the table between us and whatever comes off it when it hits.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA
rows.spoken: You can't see where all of it will fall. If a piece comes over the top, that table won't stop it.

rows.speaker: HARRY
rows.spoken: I know. I don't have a safe version. But I can see the table and I can reach the chandelier. If we keep taking this step, that thing reaches us.

rows.speaker: DRACONIA

batches.text: [breathing heavily] Then tell me what you know, even if it isn't enough. I can deal with you being frightened. I can't deal with guessing which answers you're keeping from me.

batches.speaker: DRACONIA
batches.spoken: I know whose ward it is. I thought it couldn't work anymore. I don't know who's using it now. That's what I can tell you.
batches.text: [defensive] I know whose ward it is. I thought it couldn't work anymore. I don't know who's using it now. That's what I can tell you.

batches.speaker: HARRY
batches.spoken: All right. Then we start there. But if you recognize something else, I need to hear it before I have to ask.
batches.text: [urgent] All right. Then we start there. But if you recognize something else, I need to hear it before I have to ask.

batches.speaker: DRACONIA
batches.spoken: Behind you. Harry, raise your wand. Those strings are coming straight at us.
batches.text: [voice trembling] Behind you. Harry, raise your wand. Those strings are coming straight at us.

batches.speaker: HARRY
batches.spoken: It's round my wrist. Don't pull me that way, it's tightening. I can't get the wand up.
batches.text: [breathing heavily] It's round my wrist. Don't pull me that way, it's tightening. I can't get the wand up.

batches.speaker: DRACONIA
batches.spoken: I'm not pulling your arm. I'm trying to keep you on your feet. Let your elbow come down. You're fighting it and it's getting tighter.
batches.text: [urgent] I'm not pulling your arm. I'm trying to keep you on your feet. Let your elbow come down. You're fighting it and it's getting tighter.

batches.speaker: HARRY
batches.spoken: I can feel it getting tighter. I don't know how I'm supposed to let it take my arm without losing the wand.
batches.text: [frustrated] I can feel it getting tighter. I don't know how I'm supposed to let it take my arm without losing the wand.

batches.speaker: DRACONIA
batches.spoken: Keep your fingers closed. Let me take your weight for a step. I can get my heel on the line if you give me a little room.
batches.text: [quietly] Keep your fingers closed. Let me take your weight for a step. I can get my heel on the line if you give me a little room.

batches.speaker: HARRY
batches.spoken: I thought it was going to break it. I could feel it pulling right up to my shoulder.
batches.text: [angry] I thought it was going to break it. I could feel it pulling right up to my shoulder.

batches.speaker: DRACONIA
batches.spoken: Can you open your fingers? Slowly. I'm not asking you to pretend it doesn't hurt. I need to know if you can still hold the wand.
batches.text: [frightened] Can you open your fingers? Slowly. I'm not asking you to pretend it doesn't hurt. I need to know if you can still hold the wand.

batches.speaker: HARRY
batches.spoken: Draconia, the armor behind you. Don't turn toward it. There's a trolley beside your left foot.
batches.text: [firmly] Draconia, the armor behind you. Don't turn toward it. There's a trolley beside your left foot.

batches.speaker: HARRY
batches.spoken: You nearly went down. I knew you were going to kick it, but I didn't know you were going to throw your whole weight after it.
batches.text: [urgent] You nearly went down. I knew you were going to kick it, but I didn't know you were going to throw your whole weight after it.

batches.speaker: DRACONIA
batches.spoken: Neither did I. My foot slipped. Are you all right? You caught me with the arm it just hurt.
batches.text: [breathing heavily] Neither did I. My foot slipped. Are you all right? You caught me with the arm it just hurt.

batches.speaker: HARRY
batches.spoken: I'll find out when we aren't doing this. For now, stay close enough that I don't have to catch you from across the room.
batches.text: [angry] I'll find out when we aren't doing this. For now, stay close enough that I don't have to catch you from across the room.

batches.speaker: DRACONIA
batches.spoken: Harry, I'm not trying to make this harder for you. I saw it coming and there wasn't time to do it neatly.
batches.text: [quietly] Harry, I'm not trying to make this harder for you. I saw it coming and there wasn't time to do it neatly.

batches.speaker: HARRY
batches.spoken: I know you weren't. I thought I'd lost you for a second. That's what I'm trying to say.
batches.text: [frightened] I know you weren't. I thought I'd lost you for a second. That's what I'm trying to say.

batches.speaker: HARRY
batches.spoken: It isn't just in the glass anymore. Look past the chair. It's here, and it's still doing what we do.
batches.text: [firmly] It isn't just in the glass anymore. Look past the chair. It's here, and it's still doing what we do.

batches.speaker: DRACONIA
batches.spoken: I'm trying to turn away from it. I can feel myself trying, but my feet keep taking me back. Harry, can you feel that?
batches.text: [frightened] I'm trying to turn away from it. I can feel myself trying, but my feet keep taking me back. Harry, can you feel that?

batches.speaker: HARRY
batches.spoken: Yes. Don't fight it so hard you fall. Give me a second to look. It's making us repeat the step, and the figure knows where we'll be.
batches.text: [raising voice] Yes. Don't fight it so hard you fall. Give me a second to look. It's making us repeat the step, and the figure knows where we'll be.

batches.speaker: DRACONIA
batches.spoken: Can you break the floor lines with your wand? If you can open one gap, we might be able to get out of the pattern.
batches.text: [urgent] Can you break the floor lines with your wand? If you can open one gap, we might be able to get out of the pattern.

batches.speaker: HARRY
batches.spoken: I can't keep aiming down while those things are coming at us. There's another way. The red table on our left. Could you turn it onto its side?
batches.text: [shaken] I can't keep aiming down while those things are coming at us. There's another way. The red table on our left. Could you turn it onto its side?

batches.speaker: DRACONIA
batches.spoken: If you get me close enough to reach under the edge. Why? Harry, look at me. What are you about to bring down?
batches.text: [quietly] If you get me close enough to reach under the edge. Why? Harry, look at me. What are you about to bring down?

batches.speaker: HARRY
batches.spoken: The chandelier. Across the ice, not on us. I need the table between us and whatever comes off it when it hits.
batches.text: [angry] The chandelier. Across the ice, not on us. I need the table between us and whatever comes off it when it hits.

batches.speaker: DRACONIA
batches.spoken: You can't see where all of it will fall. If a piece comes over the top, that table won't stop it.
batches.text: [defensive] You can't see where all of it will fall. If a piece comes over the top, that table won't stop it.

batches.speaker: HARRY
batches.spoken: I know. I don't have a safe version. But I can see the table and I can reach the chandelier. If we keep taking this step, that thing reaches us.
batches.text: [breathing heavily] I know. I don't have a safe version. But I can see the table and I can reach the chandelier. If we keep taking this step, that thing reaches us.

batches.speaker: DRACONIA
batches.spoken: Get me to the edge. Give me the count before you cast, and don't let go until I've got both hands on it.
batches.text: [voice trembling] Get me to the edge. Give me the count before you cast, and don't let go until I've got both hands on it.

batches.speaker: HARRY
batches.spoken: Three beats. We move on the third. If you can't get hold of it, tell me. Don't try to make it work just because I've started.
batches.text: [firmly] Three beats. We move on the third. If you can't get hold of it, tell me. Don't try to make it work just because I've started.
